changes.title: Charts for grouped statistics
changes.text: Open Options > Charts to compare groups using their counts or available totals and averages. Scroll the bars, choose a measure and tap a group for its existing detail view. Filters, rules, order and uncertainty marks match the table. Unknown values have no bar; up to 24 groups are shown with omitted groups identified.

changes.title: Chart geometry and native interaction coverage
changes.text: Regression coverage checks positive, negative, zero and extreme bar scales. Android acceptance uses real touches to open Charts, change measures repeatedly, restore scroll position and open a group after scrolling; it checks query preservation and captures count and value charts. Existing Columns and sorting checks remain required.

changes.title: Continue UIMSD after verified outcome and scrolling fixes
changes.text: The preceding private pair passed its complete core and Android suites. I am adding the native chart presentation to the existing grouped-result model. Preserve every prior Changes record and both APK variants; this adds no gameplay, scoring or save-format changes.
